description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier health and rehabilitation center. This is an exceptional opportunity for a visionary leader to make a significant impact on patient care and facility success. The ideal candidate will be responsible for overseeing all aspects of the facility's operations, ensuring the highest standards of quality care, regulatory compliance, and financial performance. You will guide a compassionate team, foster a positive environment, and drive continuous improvement initiatives.

This role requires a leader who is passionate about long-term care and committed to creating an environment where both residents and staff thrive. Join a facility dedicated to providing outstanding rehabilitation and skilled nursing services, where your leadership will directly contribute to the well-being of the community.
requirements: Current and valid Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland.
Proven experience in a leadership role within a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility.
Strong understanding of state and federal regulations governing long-term care.
Demonstrated ability to manage financial operations and achieve positive outcomes.
Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $115,000 - $145,000, commensurate with experience.

description:
We are urgently seeking a dedicated Registered Nurse (RN) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Red Bay, AL. This full-time position involves working 12-hour shifts, providing essential care to our residents during the evening and night hours. We are looking for a compassionate and skilled professional ready to make an immediate impact.

As an RN, you will be responsible for administering medications, monitoring patient conditions, documenting care, and collaborating with the healthcare team to ensure the highest standards of patient well-being. This is an excellent opportunity for an RN who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is committed to delivering exceptional patient care.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Alabama
Minimum of 1 year of experience in a skilled nursing or long-term care setting preferred
Ability to work 12-hour shifts, including evenings and nights
Strong clinical assessment, communication, and documentation skills
